hero.title: Fast & Reliable Electronics Repair
hero.subtitle: Get your devices fixed by expert technicians
hero.description: We provide professional repair and maintenance services for split ACs, non-frost refrigerators, washing machines, ovens, and other home appliances. Our team of skilled technicians focuses on delivering reliable solutions to keep your devices running smoothly.

about.title: About Us
about.description: At AH Repairing, we specialize in the repair and maintenance of split ACs, non-frost refrigerators, washing machines, ovens, and other household appliances. With a commitment to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, our experienced technicians provide fast, reliable, and cost-effective solutions to ensure your appliances perform efficiently and reliably for years to come.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: What We Do
services.description: We pride ourselves on delivering reliable, professional repair services for home appliances and electronics.
services.acDesc: Expert handling of cooling issues, gas refilling, compressor repair, leak detection, and full servicing for all split AC brands.
services.washingMachineDesc: We fix drum problems, leaks, motor faults, vibration issues, and electrical failures.
services.ovenDesc: Gas and electric models. Ignition problems, thermostat repair, heating element replacement.
services.fridgeDesc: We fix cooling faults, compressor issues, temperature control, and defrost system problems.
services.tvDesc: Expert in LED, LCD Screen issues, power faults, software errors, and board repairs.
services.dishwasherDesc: We provide spray arm service, address heater problems, fix leaks, and resolve wash cycle failures.

howWeWork.title: How We Work
howWeWork.subtitle: Our Process
howWeWork.description: A simple and efficient process designed to provide fast and reliable repair services.
howWeWork.step1Desc: Call or message us to book your repair service, and share details about the issue.
howWeWork.step2Desc: Our technician visits your location, checks the device, and identifies the exact problem.
howWeWork.step3Desc: We fix the issue using proper tools and quality spare parts to ensure reliable performance.
howWeWork.step4Desc: After repair, we test the device to make sure everything works perfectly before completing.
